facebook.content_angle: What serious buyers are actually looking for at open homes in East Auckland right now — and how sellers can use this to their advantage
facebook.post_text:
Buyers in East Auckland have never been more switched on. 🏡

Most sellers focus on price and photos — but the buyers walking through your door this autumn are evaluating things you might not expect.

👉 They notice whether the home feels lived-in and loved — or rushed to market
👉 They're comparing your home to two or three others they saw that same weekend
👉 They're asking questions your agent needs to already have sharp answers to

The sellers winning right now aren't just listing — they're preparing. 🎯

✔️ Know your home's strongest features before the first open home
✔️ Ensure every room tells a story buyers want to step into
✔️ Have your agent ready to handle objections confidently on the day

Autumn buyers are motivated and moving fast — but they're also selective. The homes that stand out aren't always the biggest or the most expensive. They're the ones that feel ready.

When your home hits the market this season, will it be the one buyers remember?
facebook.engagement_bait: Drop a 🏡 if you've ever walked into an open home and immediately known it was the one.
facebook.call_to_action: Thinking about listing this autumn? Let's talk about how to make your home the one buyers can't stop thinking about — what's your biggest question about the selling process right now?
